doc: An open embedding is an embedding with open range.
name: Topology.IsOpenEmbedding
typeText: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [tX : TopologicalSpace.{u_1} X] → [tY : TopologicalSpace.{u_2} Y] → (X → Y) → Prop

source.code:
/-- An open embedding is an embedding with open range. -/
@[fun_prop, mk_iff]
structure IsOpenEmbedding (f : X → Y) : Prop extends IsEmbedding f where
  /-- The range of an open embedding is an open set. -/
  isOpen_range : IsOpen <| range f
